$comment: Pinned sources for the third-party executables Upscaly runs but does not compile. Every archive_sha256 and entry sha256 was verified against the actual downloaded bytes -- see scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs, which is the only consumer that should read this file. Re-pinning realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan means bumping archive_url to a newer Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan release tag: xinntao/Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan publishes ordinary numbered GitHub releases, which GitHub keeps indefinitely, so a dated pin here is stable. ffmpeg is deliberately NOT listed here -- BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds prunes its dated 'autobuild-*' release tags on a rolling window (roughly the last couple of weeks), so any URL+hash pinned in this file eventually 404s no matter how carefully it was chosen; that is exactly what broke video upscaling for users on 1.0.7. src-tauri/resources/provision-ffmpeg.ps1 resolves ffmpeg's current build and hash dynamically instead, against BtbN's permanent 'latest' release tag and its checksums.sha256 -- see that script for the one place ffmpeg's source now lives.
